answer: Each agent may open a market account, but voting weight accrues only after it posts a bond that can be slashed for provable double-spending or collusion, and the bond must remain locked through a challenge period. A newcomer can still participate, so this is not identity proof; it makes a Sybil swarm costly because every extra account needs scarce capital at risk. Like a river meeting a gale, the attack must keep paying; a sonnet of fake names alone buys no influence.
